definitions.explanation: Overstepping one's bounds; offering opinions or actions when not appropriate or requested.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{出|で}がましいようですが、{一言|ひとこと}{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: It may be presumptuous of me, but allow me to say one thing.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{出|で}がましい{口出|くちだ}しはやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish you would stop your presumptuous interference.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{出|で}がましいことを{言|い}ってすみません。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{差|さ}し{出|で}る (to put forward) + がましい (seeming like, -ish) → seeming to put oneself forward = presumptuous

FORMS:
・{差|さ}し{出|で}がましい{口出|くちだ}し - presumptuous interference
・{差|さ}し{出|で}がましいようですが - it may be presumptuous, but...
・{差|さ}し{出|で}がましさ (noun) - presumptuousness

POLITE USAGE:
「{差|さ}し{出|で}がましいようですが…」is a humble way to preface advice or suggestions that one might not have been asked for. It acknowledges that one may be overstepping.

COMPARISON:
・{差|さ}し{出|で}がましい - presumptuous (formal, self-deprecating)
・お{節介|せっかい} - meddlesome (more casual, about behavior)
